description: This file defines a SupabaseClient class that provides an asynchronous interface for interacting with Supabase PostgREST endpoints, including methods for CRUD operations and paginated listing.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A lightweight async HTTP client wrapper around Supabase's PostgREST endpoints supporting user and admin modes.

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" user_mode(cls, token: str)
methods.description: Creates a SupabaseClient instance using a user JWT token with RLS enabled.

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" admin_mode(cls)
methods.description: Creates a SupabaseClient instance using a service role key with RLS bypass.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _headers(self)
methods.description: Internal method to generate the headers for HTTP requests including API key and authorization.

methods.name: httpx.Response get(self, path: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: httpx.Response post(self, path: str, json: Any)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous POST request to the specified path with JSON payload.

methods.name: httpx.Response patch(self, path: str, json: Any, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous PATCH request to the specified path with JSON payload and optional filters.

methods.name: httpx.Response upsert(self, path: str, json: Any)
methods.description: Performs an upsert (insert or update) operation on the specified path with JSON data.

methods.name: httpx.Response delete(self, path: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous DELETE request to the specified path with optional filters.

methods.name: None close(self)
methods.description: Closes the underlying HTTP client connection.

methods.name: List[dict] list_paginated( self, table: str, select: str, limit: int = 1000, offset: int = 0, extra_filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Lists rows from a specified table/view with support for pagination and optional filters.

methods.name: None __init__(self, token: Optional[str] = None, admin: bool = False)

ctags.signature: (self, path: str, json: Any, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
